question: Which of the following devices is used to accelerate charged particles to high velocities?
solution:
The correct answer is __**cyclotron**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• A **cyclotron** is a type of particle accelerator invented by **Ernest O. Lawrence** in **1934**.
 
• It accelerates charged particles using a high-frequency alternating voltage applied between two "D" shaped electrodes (called "dees") within a magnetic field.
